# Check AndroidManifest.xml: package, versionCode, uses-sdk, activity name must match MainActivity.java

# cannot find symbol = typo / missing import / wrong variable name
# 1. Check spelling of variable/method
# 2. Check import: import android.webkit.WebView;
# 3. Rebuild: javac -cp $AJ -source 8 -target 8 -d out *.java

# package does not exist = wrong import or missing android.jar
# Fix: javac -cp ~/android-sdk/platforms/android-34/android.jar -d out *.java
# Check: ls ~/android-sdk/platforms/android-34/android.jar

# Wrong Java version - class compiled with newer JDK
# Fix: javac -source 8 -target 8 -d out *.java
# Check: javac -version  # must be 17, not 21+

# Duplicate class = same class in 2 files
# Fix: ls *.java - find duplicate MainActivity.java, delete one
# Keep only one file per class name

# d8 inner class crash - DO NOT compile inner class together
# Fix: Split Bridge to separate file NinoBridge.java
# Then: javac -cp $AJ -source 8 -target 8 -d out *.java
d8 --classpath $AJ --lib $AJ --output dex/ out/*.class

# HARMLESS d8 warning - ignore it
# d8 says Activity not found because --lib $AJ missing
# Fix: add --lib $AJ : d8 --classpath $AJ --lib $AJ --output dex/ out/*.class

# File not found - wrong path or not created
# Fix: pwd
ls -lh
# Check exact name: ls ~/NINO-CODE-FIXER/
# Use full path: /data/data/com.termux/files/home/...

# Command not found - tool not installed or not in PATH
# Fix: pkg install -y <tool>
# For aapt2: export PATH=$PATH:~/android-sdk/build-tools/34.0.0
# For javac: pkg install -y openjdk-17

# Failed to load = corrupted APK / missing dex
# Fix: rebuild clean:
rm -rf out dex *.apk
mkdir -p out dex
aapt2 compile -o compiled.zip --dir res/
aapt2 link -o app.apk -I $AJ --manifest AndroidManifest.xml compiled.zip

# aapt2 link failed = bad manifest or bad XML
# Fix: check AndroidManifest.xml - package, versionCode, activity name
# Check res/*.xml - unclosed tag
# Run: aapt2 link -o app.apk -I $AJ --manifest AndroidManifest.xml -v

# Manifest malformed = missing <manifest> or <application>
# Fix: cat AndroidManifest.xml - must start <manifest package="com.nino.xxx">
# Must have <uses-sdk android:minSdkVersion="21" android:targetSdkVersion="33"/>

# Wrong keystore password
# Your key: ~/myAI/nino2.keystore pass:123456
# Fix: apksigner sign --ks ~/myAI/nino2.keystore --ks-pass pass:123456 --out app-signed.apk app.apk
# If still fails: ls -lh ~/myAI/nino2.keystore

# zipalign missing or wrong order
# Fix: zipalign must run BEFORE apksigner
# Order: aapt2 -> javac -> d8 -> zipalign -> apksigner
zipalign -f -v 4 app.apk app-aligned.apk

# d8 failed = bad .class files
# Fix: clean and rebuild:
rm -rf out dex
mkdir -p out dex
javac -cp $AJ -source 8 -target 8 -d out *.java
d8 --classpath $AJ --lib $AJ --output dex/ out/*.class

# Out of memory - Termux low RAM
# Fix: close apps, free RAM
# Then: javac -J-Xmx512m -cp $AJ -d out *.java

# WebView file not found = asset not in APK
# Fix: check assets: index.html must be in APK assets/
# In build: aapt2 link must include assets, or copy index.html to assets/
# Use: w.loadUrl("file:///android_asset/index.html")

# SSL / cert error - Termux certs outdated
# Fix: pkg install -y ca-certificates
# Or use http for local test, https for real API

# NullPointer = variable is null, you called .something on null
# Fix: find line from logcat, add null check:
# if (x != null) { x.doSomething(); }
# In Termux: logcat | grep -i null

# FileNotFound = path wrong or storage not granted
# Fix: termux-setup-storage
# Use: /data/data/com.termux/files/home/... not /sdcard/... without permission
# Check: ls -lh <path>

# EACCES = no storage permission
# Fix: termux-setup-storage
# Then: chmod +x *.sh
# Check: ls -l file.sh

# Merge conflict = same file edited twice
# Fix: git status
# Open file, delete <<<<<<< ======= >>>>>>> lines, keep correct code
# Then: git add . && git commit -m "fix conflict" && git push

# Push rejected = remote has new commits
# Fix: git pull --rebase
# Then: git push
# If still fails: git pull origin main --allow-unrelated-histories

# gh not authed
# Fix: gh auth login
# Or: gh auth status
# Check token: cat ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml

# Python module missing
# Fix: pip install <module>
# Example: pip install requests
# Check: python3 -c "import sys; print(sys.version)"

# Python SyntaxError = missing : or ) or indent
# Fix: check line from error, Python needs : after if/for/def
# Check indent: 4 spaces, no tabs

# IndentationError = mixed tabs + spaces
# Fix: use 4 spaces only, no tabs
# In Termux: cat -A file.py | grep -P "\t"  # shows tabs

# pip no internet = flight mode / no data
# Fix: check data ON, or use offline: pip install --no-index <wheel>
# Or: pkg install python-<module> if available

# curl failed = no internet or wrong URL
# Fix: ping -c1 8.8.8.8
# If flight mode: data ON
# Check URL: curl -I https://example.com

# Disk full - Termux storage full
# Fix: df -h
# Clean: rm -rf ~/storage/downloads/*.apk  # old APKs
# Check: du -sh ~/NINO* ~/myAI

# Decompile APK:
# jadx: jadx -d out app.apk
# apktool: apktool d app.apk -o out
# If not installed: pkg install -y jadx  OR  unzip -p app.apk classes.dex > classes.dex

# App crash - get log:
# adb logcat | grep -i "FATAL\|AndroidRuntime"  OR  logcat -d | tail -n 100
# Find line: Caused by: ... at com.nino.xxx.MainActivity.java:XX

# You do NOT use Gradle - you use aapt2/javac/d8
# Do NOT run gradle in Termux, it eats 500MB+
# Use your buildchain: aapt2 compile/link + javac + d8 + zipalign + apksigner

# Version missing = App not installed
# Fix in AndroidManifest.xml:
# <manifest package="com.nino.xxx" android:versionCode="1" android:versionName="1.0">

# SDK mismatch = App isn't compatible
